description:
O(n log n) polynomial multiplication via Number Theoretic Transform for `FieldPoly<F: TwoAdicField>`.

## New module `crates/gf2-core/src/field/ntt.rs`

- `pub fn ntt_inplace<F: TwoAdicField>(data: &mut [F], inverse: bool)` — radix-2 decimation-in-time FFT, bit-reversal permutation, twiddles via `TwoAdicField::two_adic_root_of_unity`. Length must be a power of two and `<= 2^F::TWO_ADICITY`.
- `FieldPoly::<F>::mul_ntt(&self, other: &Self) -> Self` — pad to next power of two, NTT both, pointwise-multiply, inverse NTT, scale by `n^{-1}` (reuse field `F::inv`), trim trailing zeros.

## Dispatch

`FieldPoly::mul` should route to `mul_ntt` when `F: TwoAdicField` and the product length exceeds a size threshold tuned by bench (expect `n >~ 128` for `Fp<65537>`). Rust coherence may force exposing this as a separate `mul_fast` method on a marker trait or as a free function. Document whichever mechanism is chosen.

`Gf2mElement` does not implement `TwoAdicField`, so it falls through to Karatsuba — no regression.

## Success criteria

- Roundtrip proptest: `inverse_ntt(ntt(x)) == x` for random vectors of power-of-two length.
- Agreement proptest: `mul_ntt(a, b) == mul_karatsuba(a, b)` for random polys of degree up to 64 over `Fp<65537>`.
- Bench in `benches/field_poly.rs` showing NTT beating Karatsuba at the crossover, results in module doc.
- `cargo fmt` / `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` / `cargo test --release` clean; budget ≤60s.
